subject: Three tall slender blue-skinned Na'vi figures of the Metkayina clan gliding together through clear open seawater, seen at a distance from the side, small against the vastness of the water. Each has a long tail that widens into a broad flattened hairless blade, all three caught mid-stroke. Their skin is turquoise with darker undulating stripes across the back and shoulders. Their forearms and lower legs show narrow flared ridges along the outer edges. Long braided hair trails behind them. They wear simple woven bands at the waist and upper arm. Below and behind them a vast pale reef slope falls away into deep blue shadow, with scattered schools of small fish through the water column.
